calls.title: Square Enix & Growthbook Technical Demo
calls.summary: The team is in the exploratory phase of evaluating GrowthBook as a baseline A/B testing tool, while awaiting an Adobe Target demo. Léonie emphasized that Japan's group intends to maintain autonomy over its 27 websites despite possibly using Adobe Target. Chris noted limitations from the lack of full ownership and source code access, which hinder experimentation. GrowthBook is being established as a free, self-hosted alternative, prioritizing developer-friendly features and cost efficiency. The integration with existing analytics tools and the ability to conduct targeted experiments were highlighted. The team values clear reporting for non-technical stakeholders and anticipates approximately 400 experiments, pending further discussions which will influence pricing.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, GrowthBook, Adobe Target, Feature Flags, Experimentation Analytics, Self-Hosting
